We can send you a draft today if that would be useful. The March totals in that draft would be marked as unverified and might change. We expect to receive confirmation on Thursday, but we cannot guarantee that timing. We will send another update by 3 p.m. Thursday, even if we are still waiting. Please let us know whether you would like the draft.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and truly appreciate your patience and understanding during this time. Thank you again for your understanding.
Best,
Alex
